description_en: Creates a rule for non-image program defense
description_zh: 新建非镜像程序防御规则
kebab_example: aliyun sas add-container-defense-rule --rule-id 500018 --rule-action 1 --rule-switch 1 --rule-name auto-test-rule-lt9umq --description test-proc-defense --rule-type 2 --whitelist '{"Path":["/test/worker.sh"],"Hash":["hashcode"],"Image":["repo:tag"]}' --scope '[{"Namespaces":["default"],"ClusterId":"8e200075b","AllNamespace":0}]' --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddContainerDefenseRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule. You do not need to manually specify the ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The action that is performed when the rule is hit. Valid values:

*   **1**: alert
*   **2**: block
parameters.help_zh:
规则命中时执行操作。取值：

- **1**：告警。

- **2**：阻断
parameters.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en:
The switch of the rule. Valid values:

*   **0**: off
*   **1**: on
parameters.name: rule_switch

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:

*   2: user-defined rules

> Only the value 2 is supported
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
- 2： 用户规则

><notice>仅支持取值2。></notice>
parameters.name: rule_type

fields.help_en:
The hash values of the files that need to be added to the whitelist.

> This parameter is not supported
fields.name: hash

fields.help_en: The paths to the files that need to be added to the whitelist
fields.help_zh: 需要加白的文件路径列表
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The images that need to be added to the whitelist
fields.name: image

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html operation to query the IDs of clusters
element_fields.help_zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html接口获取该参数
element_fields.name: cluster_id

element_fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to include all namespaces. Valid values:

*   **0**: You can use the Namespaces parameter to specify the namespaces to include.
*   **1**: All namespaces are included
element_fields.help_zh:
是否包含所有命名空间。取值：

- **0**：（用Namespaces参数）指定需要包含的命名空间。

- **1**：包含所有命名空间
element_fields.name: all_namespace
